sources.snippet: Overview Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ is a quantized instruction-following language model built by Alibaba's Qwen team, released in 2024 as part of the Qwen2.5 series. sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ is a 4-bit quantized instruction-tuned language model with 7.61B parameters, offering enhanced capabilities in coding, math, and multilingual support with 128K context length.
